title: SUNDAY MOBILITY
subtitle: SUNDAY. MOBILITY DAY. BIRD-DOG FOR BALANCE, DEAD BUG FOR LIGHT CORE, THEN WALL CHEST OPENER, CAT-COW, FIGURE-FOUR, AND A STAIR HAMSTRING STRETCH. STRETCH-HEAVY. STILL BARKED. FEEL IT. DO NOT BE SORE.

script.welcome: ON YOUR FEET. SUNDAY. MOBILITY DAY. SEVENTEEN MINUTES. BIRD DOG FOR BALANCE, DEAD BUG FOR LIGHT CORE, THEN WE OPEN THE CHEST, THE SPINE, THE HIPS, AND THE HAMSTRINGS. STRETCH HEAVY. STILL MY BLOODY SESSION. NO LYING ABOUT LIKE A DECKCHAIR IN A HEATWAVE.
script.start: MOVE. CLOCK IS RUNNING. YOU ARE NOT.
script.rest: REST. BREATHE. HANDS OFF THAT BLOODY PHONE.
script.lastSet: LAST SET. FINISH CLEAN. I'M WATCHING.
script.complete: DISMISSED. BALANCE HELD, CORE WOKE UP, CHEST AND SPINE AND HIPS AND HAMSTRINGS OPEN. GO ENJOY THE DAY LIKE A MAN WHO CAN STILL MOVE. IF I CATCH YOU FOLDED INTO THAT SOFA LIKE A DISCARDED JUMPER I WILL KNOW. I ALWAYS KNOW.

exercises.name: BIRD-DOG
exercises.cue: ON ALL FOURS, HANDS UNDER SHOULDERS, KNEES UNDER HIPS. REACH ONE ARM FORWARD AND THE OPPOSITE LEG STRAIGHT BACK UNTIL BOTH ARE LEVEL WITH THE TORSO. HOLD A BEAT, RETURN WITH CONTROL, SWITCH SIDES. EIGHT EACH SIDE. HIPS SQUARE TO THE FLOOR — NO WAGGING. THIS IS YOUR BALANCE WORK.
exercises.speakStart: BIRD DOG. THREE SETS. EIGHT EACH SIDE. ALL FOURS. OPPOSITE ARM AND LEG. HIPS SQUARE. THIS IS YOUR BALANCE. A BLOODY POINTER DOG WITH STANDARDS, NOT A WOBBLY TABLE.
exercises.speakRest: TWENTY FIVE. SWITCH SIDE WHEN YOU'RE READY. EYES ON YOU.
exercises.speakDone: BIRD DOGS DONE. BALANCE SWITCHED ON. GOOD.

exercises.name: DEAD BUG
exercises.cue: LIE ON YOUR BACK, ARMS UP, KNEES BENT OVER HIPS. PRESS THE LOW BACK GENTLY INTO THE FLOOR. REACH ONE ARM BACK AND THE OPPOSITE LEG OUT LONG WITHOUT ARCHING. RETURN, SWITCH. EIGHT EACH SIDE. SLOW AND CLEAN. LIGHT CORE STRENGTH — FEEL IT, DO NOT BE SORE.
exercises.speakStart: DEAD BUG. THREE SETS. EIGHT EACH SIDE. BACK FLAT. OPPOSITE ARM AND LEG. SLOW. LIGHT CORE. YOUR MIDDLE HAS BEEN SITTING AT A DESK LIKE A BLOODY CUSHION ALL WEEK. WAKE IT UP.
exercises.speakRest: TWENTY FIVE. STAY ON THE FLOOR. BREATHE.
exercises.speakDone: DEAD BUGS DONE. CORE ONLINE. GOOD.

exercises.name: WALL CHEST OPENER
exercises.cue: STAND SIDE-ON TO AN OPEN WALL. PLACE THE FOREARM AND OPEN PALM ON THE WALL AT ABOUT SHOULDER HEIGHT, ELBOW SOFT. STEP THE SAME-SIDE FOOT FORWARD A TOUCH AND GENTLY TURN THE CHEST AWAY FROM THE WALL UNTIL YOU FEEL A STRETCH ACROSS THE CHEST AND FRONT OF THE SHOULDER. HOLD THIRTY SECONDS. SWITCH SIDES. NO FORCING.
exercises.speakStart: WALL CHEST OPENER. TWO ROUNDS. THIRTY SECONDS EACH SIDE. FOREARM ON THE WALL. TURN THE CHEST AWAY. GENTLE. THAT DESK HAS FOLDED YOUR SHOULDERS FORWARD LIKE A BLOODY PRAYING MANTIS. OPEN THEM.

exercises.name: CAT-COW
exercises.cue: ON ALL FOURS, HANDS UNDER SHOULDERS, KNEES UNDER HIPS. INHALE: DROP THE BELLY, LIFT THE CHEST AND TAILBONE (COW). EXHALE: ROUND THE SPINE, TUCK THE CHIN AND PELVIS (CAT). MOVE SLOW AND EVEN FOR FORTY-FIVE SECONDS. NO FORCING THE END RANGE. THIS IS MOBILITY, NOT A CIRCUS.
exercises.speakStart: CAT COW. TWO ROUNDS. FORTY FIVE SECONDS. ALL FOURS. INHALE OPEN THE CHEST. EXHALE ROUND THE SPINE. SLOW. THAT SPINE HAS BEEN PARKED IN A CHAIR ALL WEEK. UNSTICK IT.

exercises.name: FIGURE-FOUR STRETCH
exercises.cue: LIE ON YOUR BACK. CROSS ONE ANKLE OVER THE OPPOSITE KNEE. REACH THROUGH AND PULL THE BOTTOM THIGH TOWARD YOUR CHEST UNTIL YOU FEEL A STRETCH IN THE OUTER HIP AND GLUTE OF THE CROSSED LEG. HOLD THIRTY SECONDS. SWITCH SIDES. KEEP THE HEAD AND SHOULDERS RELAXED ON THE FLOOR. BREATHE INTO THE STRETCH.
exercises.speakStart: FIGURE FOUR. TWO ROUNDS. THIRTY SECONDS EACH SIDE. ANKLE ON THE KNEE. PULL THE THIGH IN. OUTER HIP OPENS. THOSE HIPS HAVE BEEN LOCKED AT THAT DESK LIKE A RUSTY GATE. OIL THEM.

exercises.name: STAIR HAMSTRING STRETCH
exercises.cue: PLACE ONE HEEL ON A LOW STAIR, LEG MOSTLY STRAIGHT, SOFT KNEE. HINGE AT THE HIPS WITH A LONG SPINE UNTIL YOU FEEL A GENTLE STRETCH IN THE BACK OF THE THIGH. HOLD THIRTY SECONDS. SWITCH LEGS. NO BOUNCING. BREATHE INTO THE STRETCH.
exercises.speakStart: STAIR HAMSTRING STRETCH. TWO ROUNDS. THIRTY SECONDS EACH LEG. HEEL ON THE STEP. HINGE. LONG SPINE. GENTLE. THOSE HAMSTRINGS HAVE BEEN SHORT ALL WEEK. GIVE THEM SOME AIR.
exercises.speakDone: HAMSTRINGS OPEN. THAT IS THE LOT. WELL DONE.
